subject: Obtaining predicted logits from mixed mirt call

messages.author: bae2153d4f34419e
messages.subject: Obtaining predicted logits from mixed mirt call
parts:
Hi Phil,

I was wondering if there is  a method to obtain the predicted logits  from a mixed mirt object.

I am interested in obtaining predicted probabilities from a subject that the model was not trained with.

Please let me know if I can provide any further clarifications.

Best,
Adon

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Obtaining predicted logits from mixed mirt call
parts:
Hi Adon,

I don't believe there's a direct way to do this in the package, mostly because of the presence of the additional random effect structure (which, to obtain point estimates from, are obtained via MCMC sampling). To obtain these you'd need to form the implied probability functions manually to obtain the respective posterior probabilities from the full structure; so, potentially more work than it's worth. 

Phil
